bench-wiring.text: For the optional quantization bench only, the violet lead is wired to jack Q7; this hardware detail does not concern course organization or the theory of response and stability.

materials-orientation.text: Updated orientation from learner's lecturer check: response and stability are recurring viewpoints on systems rather than independent course modules; the frequency chapter revisits both viewpoints instead of forming a third independent module. For current conventions, use Lumen and the current discrete-time lab convention with impulse response written g[n]. Atlas remains useful for longer derivations, but may use different notation such as h for impulse response. Older or misleading lab sheets may assume continuous time with g(t), so do not infer the current lab domain from those sheets. This is course/material orientation only; it is not evidence that the learner has learned the mathematics.
